verse.verse_2: that the blind man came to him.
verse.verse_3: How could you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself,
verse.verse_4: or he might be mindful and good counsel might avail him.
verse.verse_7: though you are not to blame if he would not cleanse himself.
verse.verse_8: But he who comes to you running,
verse.verse_10: you pay no heed to him.
verse.verse_11: No indeed; this is only a Reminder.
verse.verse_12: So whoso wills may give heed to it.
verse.verse_13: It is contained in scrolls highly honoured,
verse.verse_15: borne by the hands of scribes,
verse.verse_17: Accursed be man! How stubbornly he denies the Truth.
verse.verse_18: Out of what did Allah create him?
verse.verse_19: Out of a sperm-drop did He create him and then determined a measure for him,
verse.verse_20: and then made the course of life easy for him,
verse.verse_21: then He caused him to die and brought him to the grave,
verse.verse_22: and then, whenever He wishes, He will raise him back to life.
verse.verse_23: Nay, but man did not fulfil what Allah had enjoined upon him.
verse.verse_24: So let man just consider his food:
verse.verse_25: We poured water, pouring it in great abundance,
verse.verse_26: and cleaved the earth, cleaving it asunder;
verse.verse_27: then caused the grain to grow out of it,
verse.verse_32: all this as a provision for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_33: But when the deafening cry shall be sounded
verse.verse_34: on the Day when each man shall flee from his brother,
verse.verse_35: and his mother and his father;
verse.verse_36: and his consort and his children;
verse.verse_37: on that Day each will be occupied with his own business, making him oblivious of all save himself.
verse.verse_38: Some faces on that Day shall be beaming with happiness,
verse.verse_40: Some faces on that Day shall be dust-ridden,
verse.verse_42: These will be the unbelievers, the wicked.
